answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the mesa of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The vault is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ocean. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit.
